description: Write UTF-8 text inside the managed ReSync Flow-files area. The capability normalizes and authorizes the logical path before writing, and the Result output reports any policy or storage failure.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the write when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Managed logical path of the UTF-8 file to replace.

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: UTF-8 text that replaces the file contents.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the file was written successfully.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when path policy, storage availability, or the write operation fails.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports whether the write completed and includes a stable failure code when it did not.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True only when the file was written.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing why the write failed, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable write result or failure explanation.

description: Append UTF-8 text inside the managed ReSync Flow-files area. The capability validates the logical path before changing the file and exposes the operation outcome as a Result.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the append when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Managed logical path of the UTF-8 file to extend.

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: UTF-8 text added after the existing file contents.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when text was appended successfully.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when path policy, storage availability, or the append operation fails.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports whether the append completed and includes a stable failure code when it did not.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True only when text was appended.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing why the append failed, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable append result or failure explanation.

description: Read UTF-8 text from the managed ReSync Flow-files area. The capability validates the logical path and returns an empty content value on a failed operation together with its stable Result code.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the read when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Managed logical path of the UTF-8 file to read.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the file was read successfully.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when path policy, storage availability, or the read operation fails.

outputs.name: content
outputs.description: UTF-8 text read from the managed file, or an empty string after failure.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports the file text on success or a stable read failure.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True only when the file was read.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing why the read failed, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable read result or failure explanation.

description: Read a managed UTF-8 file as an ordered list of lines. Path access is validated before reading, and failed reads take the Failed route with a stable Result code.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the line read when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Managed logical path of the UTF-8 file to read as lines.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the file lines were read successfully.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when path policy, storage availability, or the line read fails.

outputs.name: lines
outputs.description: Returns the file lines in source order, or an empty list after failure.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports the ordered lines on success or a stable read failure.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True only when the file lines were read.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing why the line read failed, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable line read result or failure explanation.

description: Preview or delete a managed file inside the ReSync Flow-files area. Preview reports the target without changing it. An actual delete requires the trusted flow policy and reports a stable Result.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the delete or preview when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Managed logical path of the file to inspect or delete.

inputs.name: preview
inputs.description: When true, reports what would be deleted without changing the file.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the requested delete or preview completes successfully.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the path is invalid, unavailable, missing, or cannot be deleted.

outputs.name: preview
outputs.description: Reports whether the operation was a preview.

outputs.name: would_delete
outputs.description: Reports whether the target existed and would be deleted by a non-preview operation.

outputs.name: deleted
outputs.description: True only when a non-preview delete removed the file.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports the deletion outcome and stable failure information.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when the preview or deletion completed successfully.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing why the delete failed, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable delete result or failure explanation.

description: Check whether a managed logical path exists in the ReSync Flow-files area. The node validates the path and returns false with a stable Result when storage is unavailable or the operation fails.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the existence check when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Managed logical path to inspect.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the existence check completes.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when path policy, storage availability, or the existence check fails.

outputs.name: exists
outputs.description: Reports whether the managed path exists. Failure also returns false.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports the existence value or a stable failure code.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the existence check itself completed without failure.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing why the check failed, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable existence result or failure explanation.

description: Copy a managed file to another logical path inside the ReSync Flow-files area. Both paths are normalized under the capability boundary before the copy is attempted.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the copy when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: source_path
inputs.description: Managed logical path of the existing file to copy.

inputs.name: dest_path
inputs.description: Managed logical path receiving the copied file.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the file copy succeeds.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when either path is invalid or the copy fails.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports whether the copy completed and includes stable failure information.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True only when the destination was copied successfully.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing why the copy failed, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable copy result or failure explanation.

description: Move a managed file to another logical path inside the ReSync Flow-files area. The capability validates both paths and keeps the operation inside the managed storage boundary.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the move when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: source_path
inputs.description: Managed logical path of the existing file to move.

inputs.name: dest_path
inputs.description: Managed logical path receiving the moved file.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the file move succeeds.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when either path is invalid or the move fails.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports whether the move completed and includes stable failure information.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True only when the source was moved successfully.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing why the move failed, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable move result or failure explanation.

description: List direct entries in a managed ReSync Flow-files directory. The returned paths are normalized logical paths, and inaccessible directories fail closed with an empty list and stable Result code.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the directory listing when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Managed logical directory path to list.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the directory was listed successfully.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when path policy, storage availability, or listing fails.

outputs.name: files
outputs.description: Returns direct managed entries in deterministic path order, or an empty list after failure.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports the listed paths or a stable listing failure.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True only when the directory listing completed.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing why listing failed, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable listing result or failure explanation.

description: Create a directory inside the managed ReSync Flow-files area. Existing directories are reported as successful without being replaced, while invalid or unavailable paths use the Failed route.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts directory creation when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Managed logical directory path to create.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the directory exists after the operation.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when path policy, storage availability, or creation fails.

outputs.name: created
outputs.description: Returns true when a new directory is created. Returns false when it already exists.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports the directory operation and stable failure information.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when the directory exists after the operation.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing why creation failed, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable directory result or failure explanation.

description: Read the byte size of a managed file in the ReSync Flow-files area. The path is normalized and authorized before reading, and failure is reported without exposing host paths.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the size read when execution reaches this node.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Managed logical path of the file whose size should be read.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the file size was read successfully.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when path policy, storage availability, or the size read fails.

outputs.name: size
outputs.description: Returns the file size in bytes, or zero after failure.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Reports the byte size or a stable failure code.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True only when the file size was read.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable code describing why the size read failed, or an empty string after success.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable size result or failure explanation.
